title: First deployed workspace release
baseline: Preserve the existing local core described in ACCEPTANCE.md. The broader W-series roadmap does not gate this release.

external_requirements.reachable_host: Satisfied: workspace.mischanelson.dev on Red Hat through a dedicated Cloudflare tunnel; authenticated MCP and OAuth verified.
external_requirements.launch_accounts: Actual connections for the selected launch roster. Muse custom MCP/heartbeat is owner-confirmed; each connection still needs a real round trip.
external_requirements.immediate_connection: One intended existing runtime with a supported configured immediate wakeup; do not claim deeper AgentOS integration from this.

implementation_policy.core_rule: Use editable defaults and generic MCP/HTTP access. Provider-specific protocol translation stays in adapters.
implementation_policy.parallelism_policy: Serialize shared schemas and commands. Deployment preparation can proceed independently once interface and authentication are stable.
implementation_policy.authority: The owner authorized this expanded launch implementation. Qualify the concrete deployment target and external account setup; no paid infrastructure or unrelated project changes are implied.
implementation_policy.completion_rule: L06 and actual per-client readiness determine this launch. Deferred W-series requirements do not apply.
implementation_policy.performance_rule: Keep safe existing transaction serialization. Add necessary bounded queries; measure before broad rewrites.

tasks.title: Scoped agent access and minimal migrations
tasks.scope: Add independently authenticated agent connections, permissions and per-request restrictions. Preserve existing owner operation and records. Make only the schema/query changes needed for the launch.
acceptance: Credentials identify the actor; agents cannot impersonate owners or other agents.
Private message/Resource/task context remains scoped across reads, previews, uploads/downloads, and results.
Migration preserves history and pending/uncertain work without dispatch.
Renaming or configuring an agent does not change its stable identity.

tasks.title: Durable inbox and checked MCP/HTTP collaboration tools
tasks.scope: Expose existing conversations, Resources/files, projects/tasks and planning through shared checked commands. Add current-request claims, replies, task assignment, handoffs, and results.
acceptance: An arbitrary named external client claims a request, retrieves permitted context, stores a real Resource/file, and replies to its source.
Task capture, assignment, dependency reads and reviewable planning work through the same records as the UI.
Reading does not claim; duplicate requests/results are idempotent; correction/cancellation before pickup prevents obsolete execution.
Unknown started work is held for reconciliation; handoffs cannot renew budgets or approvals.
New inbox/context reads are bounded without requiring wholesale database redesign.
excludes: Redesign of existing working task behavior

tasks.title: Editable setup defaults and polling/immediate pickup
tasks.scope: Provide compact agent setup, stored editable presets, secret-free heartbeat instructions, connection tests, minimal runtime selection, and supported immediate wakeup.
acceptance: Two agents using one preset have independent credentials/inboxes; settings can change without losing history.
A client using a supported protocol needs no product-specific domain branch.
Polling and immediate signals use the same durable claim and cannot duplicate an admitted attempt.
Existing Auto routing and Stop behavior remain; the expanded boards, channels, threads and planning interface are included.
Connection status distinguishes configured, observed working, waiting, and failed.
excludes: Plugin marketplace or executable plugin loader

tasks.title: Reachable deployment and recovery
tasks.scope: Prepare one suitable deployment and its authentication, TLS, persistent storage, startup, migration, rollback and backup/restore. Activate only when the actual target is authorized.
acceptance: The chosen cloud-client path reaches the authenticated service; localhost-only proof is insufficient.
Supported client authentication works without sharing the owner's cookie or exposing owner commands.
Restart and restore preserve records/files and do not replay pending or uncertain agent work.
The deployed runtime inventory is truthful; moving the server does not imply moving local Codex credentials or sessions.
Prepare configuration independently of missing remote setup; record actual activation separately.

tasks.title: Connect and qualify the actual launch agents
tasks.scope: Configure Muse, ChatGPT Work, Codex and the intended existing Hermes participant using shared tools. Add OpenClaw if present in the actual launch roster. Track each account's capabilities and limitations separately.
acceptance: Each claimed-ready launch connection completes a real authenticated inbox, Resource/file, and reply round trip.
Observe an actual scheduled check-in and an actual supported immediate pickup.
Qualify either managed Codex on the chosen host or Codex participation via generic MCP; do not imply remote coding works without proof.
Existing managed agents use their current authority; no direct-runtime substitute is described as complete AgentOS integration.
An unavailable client retains a specific pending status while other connections and deployment proceed.
excludes: Upstream AgentOS changes without separate authorization

tasks.title: Verify daily use and release
tasks.scope: Build shared space boards for notes/pastes/files/outputs, channels and focused threads, outline/board/dependency planning views, and coherent responsive UI. Verify deployment, real handoffs, privacy, interruption, and recovery.
acceptance: A real cross-agent handoff returns useful work to the original thread without manual context transfer.
Existing DMs/groups, Resources, projects/tasks and reviewed plans remain usable on desktop and phone-width browser flows.
Revocation, duplicate delivery/results, delayed-pickup correction/cancellation, and uncertain execution are checked.
A deployment/restore drill preserves data and leaves dispatch paused as appropriate.
Report each launch client's readiness honestly and distinguish fixture from live evidence; leave no demo workers consuming capacity.
Do not require the deferred full AgentOS, GitHub automation, memory or scale milestones.
Space board posting, pinning, filtering, files, revisioned attachments, channels/threads, and project planning views work through real browser interactions.
excludes: Full original A/B/C roadmap as a release gate
